name: Bird Hunter: Wild Wings Edition
summary: Hunting deer not enough for you? Get ready with your bird guns as you get your chances to shoot at 15 different species of birds... Virtually. Different birds require different strategies, and you can even get a few AI dogs to help you flush out the prey for you to shoot. And the dogs will even retrieve the prey... If you hit it, that is. You even get to pick the different species of dogs, different weapons, different locations, and equipment such as calls, decoys, and blinds.
